title: Case 034: Explaining a service fee
initial_request: I can see a £3.20 fee beside a foreign-currency cash withdrawal in my H&V secure portal, but I don't understand what the charge is for or how its amount was determined. Please check the fee against the tariff that applied to that transaction.
overview: Mara Ellery queried a £3.20 fee shown against a foreign-currency cash withdrawal. After the request was escalated under case HV-034, an H&V agent compared the transaction record with the tariff applicable on its processing date. H&V sent a secure explanation identifying the fee basis and confirming the amount matched the applicable tariff entry. No refund decision was made.

next_action.summary: Compare the recorded transaction type with the H&V tariff in force on the transaction's processing date.

outcome: H&V explained that the £3.20 debit was the fee for the recorded foreign-currency cash withdrawal, applied under the tariff entry in force on the processing date, and confirmed the amount matched that entry. Whether any refund is due remains undecided.

events.body: A £3.20 service fee is shown beside your foreign-currency cash withdrawal. The transaction and fee are listed in your secure portal.
I don't understand the £3.20 fee shown against this withdrawal. Please escalate this and check which tariff entry applied and how it accounts for the amount.
I am starting the review by matching the recorded transaction type and processing date against the tariff in force on that date. Case HV-034; no refund or account change is authorised by this review.

I checked the transaction record against the applicable tariff entry. The record identifies a foreign-currency cash withdrawal, and the £3.20 fee matches the entry applicable to that transaction on its processing date.

I have checked the transaction against the tariff in force on its processing date. The £3.20 debit is the fee for the recorded foreign-currency cash withdrawal, and its amount matches the applicable tariff entry. This explains the charge; no refund decision has been made.
